三个月研修 · 返回原单位: Three-month training · Return to your unit
出门前，你花 ¥600 托人照看: Before leaving, you spend ¥600 to have someone look after
毕业前后，同学在群里商量去哪儿走一趟。有人列了车票和青旅的价钱，也有人已经收拾好: Around graduation, classmates discuss in the group chat where to go for a trip. Some list ticket and hostel prices, and some have already packed for their internships.
你们住上下铺，轮着提水壶。站台上的合照，后来留了很多年。: You share bunk beds and take turns carrying the kettle. The group photo on the platform was kept for many years.
你们在海边等了一次日出。回去以后，有人去了很远的城市。: You wait for a sunrise by the sea. After returning, some go off to cities far away.
不去，直接实习: Skip it and start the internship
他们发照片的时候，你刚领到临时工牌。你说回来请你们吃饭。: When they post their photos, you've just been issued a temporary work badge. You say you'll treat them to a meal when they're back.
新的收入、新的房租，也要重新认识身边的人。: New income, new rent, and getting to know the people around you all over again.
朋友发来两张招聘启事，一张在一线，一张在新一线。租约快到期了，这回搬家可以搬得更: A friend sends two job postings, one in a tier-one city and one in a new tier-one city. Your lease is almost up, so this time you can move farther.
箱子放在新租的屋里。工资高了一点，房租也高了一截。: The boxes sit in the newly rented room. The pay is a little higher, and the rent a good deal higher.
去新一线（搬家 ¥3,000）: Go to a new tier-one city (moving ¥3,000)
你先找好房子，再搬过去。楼下有家便宜的面馆，老板很快记住了你。: You find a place first, then move. There's a cheap noodle shop downstairs, and the owner soon remembers you.
你续了租。熟悉的路还在，朋友约饭不用再问地址。: You renew the lease. The familiar roads are still there, and when friends invite you to dinner, you don't have to ask the address.
短期去，按期回来；补贴背后是家里半年的空缺。: Go for a short time and return on schedule; behind the allowance is half a year's absence from home.
厂里问你，愿不愿去东南亚的工厂做半年技术指导。: The factory asks if you'd go to a plant in Southeast Asia for half a year of technical guidance.
公司问你，愿不愿去海外分公司支援半年。: The company asks if you'd support an overseas branch for half a year.
结束就回来，半年补贴 ¥3 万。: You come back when it's over, with a half-year allowance of ¥30,000.
接送孩子和家里的事，要重新安排。: The school runs and family matters will have to be rearranged.
你把日期在日历上圈了出来。: You circle the dates on the calendar.
去半年，安排好家里: Go for half a year and arrange things at home
你带着箱子出发，按期回到原来的岗位。门口那家早餐铺还在。: You set off with your suitcase and return to your old post on schedule. The breakfast shop by the door is still there.
这次让给别人: Let someone else go this time
你把名单推了回去。送行那天，帮同事提了一段箱子。: You push the list back. On the day of the send-off, you carry a colleague's suitcase for part of the way.
争取只去三个月: Try to go for only three months
交接方案通过了。三个月后，你按计划回来。: The handover plan is approved. Three months later, you return as planned.
短期方案没通过。你留在原岗，同事去了。: The short-term plan isn't approved. You stay at your post, and a colleague goes.
带回一点本事，家里的三个月也得有人照应。: You bring back some skills, but someone has to look after things at home for those three months.
学校给了你一个去国外学校听课的名额。: The school gives you a place to sit in on classes at a school abroad.
院里给了你一个去国外医院研修的名额。: The hospital gives you a place for training at a hospital abroad.
单位有一个去国外学习公共服务的研修名额。: Your unit has a place for training abroad in public services.
三个月，结束回原单位，自己出 ¥5,000。: Three months, returning to your unit afterwards, with ¥5,000 out of your own pocket.
去研修，先交接妥当: Go for the training after handing over properly
你记满两本笔记。回来以后，把能用的几页复印给了同事。: You fill two notebooks. After returning, you photocopy the useful pages for colleagues.
让给年轻人: Give the place to a younger person
年轻同事回来的时候，给你带了一本当地的薄册子。: When the young colleague returns, they bring you a thin local booklet.
先去，家里有急事就回来: Go first, and come back if there's an emergency at home
家里临时需要人照应，你提前两周赶回来。剩下的课，托同事带回了讲义。: Home suddenly needs looking after, and you hurry back two weeks early. For the remaining classes, you ask a colleague to bring back the handouts.
孩子翻出地图，说同学暑假要去看海。你算了一遍存款和能请的假，日历上还写着补习班开: The child digs out a map and says classmates are going to see the sea this summer. You tally your savings and the leave you can take, with the tutoring class start date still marked on the calendar.
带饭去附近公园（¥100）: Pack a lunch for a nearby park (¥100)
周边自驾或租车（¥2,000）: Drive or rent a car nearby (¥2,000)
你们带着饭盒出门，在树下找了一片阴凉。孩子捡回一块像小船的石头。: You go out with lunch boxes and find shade under a tree. The child picks up a stone shaped like a little boat.
国内跟团看海（¥6,000）: Group tour to the seaside in China (¥6,000)
团餐不合口味，海风倒是真的。回程箱子里全是沙。: The group meals don't suit your taste, but the sea breeze is real. On the way back the suitcase is full of sand.
孩子拿着登机牌一路看，回来把车票贴满了本子。: The child looks at the boarding pass all the way, and after returning fills a notebook with pasted tickets.
先上补习班（¥1,500）: Enrol in the tutoring class first (¥1,500)
你把地图收好，说下次。周末送孩子去教室时，天很蓝。: You put the map away and say next time. When you take the child to the classroom at the weekend, the sky is very blue.
同学发来毕业旅行的旧照，你认出当年没赶上的那趟车。: A classmate sends old photos from the graduation trip, and you recognise the train you missed back then.
毕业旅行的合照又被翻出来，群里聊了好一阵。: The group photo from the graduation trip resurfaces, and the chat goes on for quite a while.
你想起当年续租留下的决定，如今住处是否还在原地，日子都已往前走了。: You think of the decision to renew the lease back then; whether or not you still live in the same place, life has moved on.
当年搬家的照片又被翻出来，那些第一次找路的日子，现在想起来已经熟悉。: Photos from the move back then turn up again, and those first days finding your way around now feel familiar in memory.
外派回来的同事送你一包点心，讲起那半年的饭菜。: A colleague back from assignment gives you a bag of snacks and talks about the food during those six months.
短期外派带回来的经验，帮你接住了一次难办的交接。: The experience brought back from the short-term assignment helps you handle a difficult handover.
年轻同事把研修的笔记借给你，你挑了几页复印。: A young colleague lends you their training notes, and you photocopy a few pages.
那本研修笔记还在抽屉里，用得上的地方折了角。: That training notebook is still in the drawer, with the useful parts dog-eared.
你又想起当年收好的地图，给下一个假期留了两天空。: You think again of the map you put away back then, and leave two free days for the next holiday.
翻到那次出游的照片，你想起孩子当时带回的小东西。: Finding the photos from that outing, you remember the little thing the child brought back.
你和伴侣一起看了一会儿，各自记得的细节不太一样。: You look through them for a while with your partner, each remembering slightly different details.
你把照片慢慢翻完，留在那一年的笑声仍然清楚。: You slowly flip through all the photos, and the laughter from that year is still clear.
